summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is highly concentrated, with Hugging Face dominating open-source hosting at over 2 million models while the top 0.01% of models account for nearly half of all downloads. Deployment platforms like Ollama, Replicate, Together AI, Fireworks AI, and AWS Bedrock serve distinct segments ranging from local hobbyist inference to enterprise-grade scalable APIs. The ecosystem is bifurcating between open-weight model hosting and managed inference layers, with Qwen derivatives and OpenAI-compatible APIs driving the majority of adoption across both categories.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: The central open-source hub for discovering, sharing, and versioning machine learning models, datasets, and Spaces (demo apps). Acts as the GitHub of AI with collaborative tools and a model registry.
platforms.model_count: 2,000,000+ models (3 million repositories total as of mid-2026)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and datasets; PRO plan at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour based on hardware (CPU from ~$0.06/hr, GPU from ~$0.60/hr)
features: 2M+ public models with 45.4 billion all-time downloads as of Oct 2025
Model cards, versioning, and dataset integration
Spaces for interactive demos powered by Gradio or Streamlit
Inference Endpoints for one-click private deployments
Supports GGUF, LoRA, MLX, LeRobot, and 100+ framework libraries
30%+ of Fortune 500 companies maintain verified accounts
Private model repos, SSO, and audit logs on Enterprise tier
Active community forums and leaderboards
platforms.best_for: Researchers, data scientists, and enterprises that need to discover, fine-tune, share, or deploy open-weight models with full transparency and community support.

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: A local model runtime that allows developers to download and run open-weight LLMs directly on their own hardware (Mac, Windows, Linux) with a simple CLI and REST API interface.
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in the official library (including Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Gemma, Phi families)
platforms.pricing: Completely free and open-source; costs are only your own hardware and electricity
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g., ollama run qwen3:8b)
Local REST API compatible with OpenAI API schema
GPU acceleration on Apple Silicon (Metal), NVIDIA CUDA, and AMD ROCm
Model quantization via GGUF format for reduced memory footprint
Multimodal model support including vision models
Modelfile system for custom system prompts and parameter tuning
Zero data egress — fully air-gapped and private
Active library of community-contributed Modelfiles
platforms.best_for: Individual developers, privacy-focused users, and teams that want to run open-weight models completely locally without API costs or data leaving their machine.

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: A cloud platform for running open-source and community-contributed AI models via a simple API, with a strong focus on media generation models including image, video, audio, and 3D.
platforms.model_count: 100,000+ public models contributed by the community
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second of compute time; CPU from ~$0.0001/sec, GPU (T4) from ~$0.00055/sec, A100 from ~$0.0023/sec; no minimum spend or subscription required
features: Instant API access to any public model with no infrastructure setup
Strong catalog of image generation models (Stable Diffusion, FLUX, etc.)
Video and audio generation model support
Fine-tuning workflows with Dreambooth and LoRA directly on platform
Deployments feature for scaling dedicated endpoints
Webhooks and async prediction support for production workflows
Python, JavaScript, and HTTP client SDKs
Community model publishing with versioning
platforms.best_for: Product developers and startups building creative or generative media applications who need rapid prototyping and pay-as-you-go pricing without managing GPU infrastructure.

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: A cloud inference and fine-tuning platform optimized for open-source LLMs, offering high-throughput serverless and dedicated endpoints with a strong focus on speed and developer experience.
platforms.model_count: 200+ leading open-weight models including Llama, Qwen, Mistral, DBRX, and Mixtral families
platforms.pricing: Serverless inference priced per million tokens (e.g., Llama 3.1 8B at ~$0.18/M tokens, Llama 3.1 70B at ~$0.88/M tokens); dedicated GPU instances also available; free $25 credit on signup
features: OpenAI-compatible API for drop-in replacement workflows
Serverless inference with industry-competitive latency
Fine-tuning service for custom model training on proprietary data
Together Embeddings API for vector search use cases
Batch inference at reduced cost for offline workloads
Support for function calling and JSON mode on supported models
Team management and usage dashboards
RedPajama open dataset contributions and research focus
platforms.best_for: AI engineers and enterprises needing fast, affordable inference on the latest open-weight models with fine-tuning capabilities and OpenAI API compatibility for easy migration.

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: A high-performance inference platform specializing in extremely fast token generation for open-source LLMs, targeting production applications requiring low latency and high throughput.
platforms.model_count: 150+ open-weight models with a curated focus on top-performing LLMs and code models
platforms.pricing: Per-million-token pricing; Llama 3.1 8B from ~$0.20/M tokens; Mixtral 8x7B from ~$0.50/M tokens; compound AI and image generation priced separately; volume discounts available
features: Industry-leading token generation speeds via custom inference stack (FireAttention)
OpenAI-compatible REST API with streaming support
Serverless and on-demand dedicated deployments
Support for function calling, grammar mode, and structured JSON output
Image generation API including FLUX and SDXL models
Fine-tuned model hosting and deployment
Compound AI system support for multi-model pipelines
SLA guarantees and enterprise support tiers
platforms.best_for: Production engineering teams building latency-sensitive applications such as real-time chat, coding assistants, and agent pipelines that require the fastest possible open-model inference.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: A fully managed AWS service that provides access to foundation models from leading AI companies (Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Amazon, Cohere, AI21) via a unified API integrated into the AWS cloud ecosystem.
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from multiple providers including Amazon Nova, Claude, Llama, Mistral, Cohere, and Titan families
platforms.pricing: On-demand pay-per-token pricing varies by model (e.g., Claude Haiku 3.5 at $0.80/M input tokens; Llama 3.1 70B at ~$0.99/M tokens); Provisioned Throughput for reserved capacity billed hourly; no upfront cost
features: Single API for models from Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Cohere, Amazon, and AI21
Native integration with AWS services (S3, Lambda, SageMaker, IAM, CloudWatch)
Bedrock Agents for building autonomous multi-step AI workflows
Knowledge Bases with managed RAG pipelines and vector storage
Guardrails for content filtering and PII redaction
Model evaluation and A/B testing tools
Fine-tuning and continued pre-training on custom data
VPC support, PrivateLink, and SOC2/HIPAA compliance for enterprise security
platforms.best_for: Enterprise teams already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need governed, compliant, and deeply integrated AI capabilities with access to both proprietary and open-weight frontier models.
